messages:
carol: starting rollout v2.14.0 — staging smoke passed, promoting canary to prod 10% now. deploy-bot: release v2.14.0 started by carol. canary 10% -> running smoke tests.

jon: canary healthchecks failing, 502 from web -> redis layer returning bad payloads. seen in 2 pods.

sre-robot: alert: redis value_serialization mismatch between environments detected by prod-smoke-check. key: redis.serializer

laura: quick check: staging values show “redis.serializer: json” but prod values.yaml (values-prod.yaml) doesn't set it, fallback is legacy. that explains deserialization errors. looks like a missing prod override.

patrick: oof. so staging and prod have different serializer defaults. do we rollback or patch?

carol: options: A) rollback to previous image (v2.13.7) — fast. B) patch prod values/configmap to set serializer=json and restart pods — lower code risk but touches infra live. thoughts? :thinking_face:

jon: lean rollback. we already pinned canary image earlier but prod image wasn't pinned. rollback buys us time to fix values and add parity checks. +1 to rollback.

laura: if we patch, command would be something like:
```bash
# patch helm values-prod.yaml then upgrade with reuse-values
helm upgrade frontend ./charts/frontend -n prod -f values-prod.yaml --reuse-values --set redis.serializer=json
kubectl rollout restart deploy/frontend -n prod
```
but that requires helm access and immediate restart during change window.

carol: i triggered rollback to v2.13.7 for the canary. deploy-bot: rollback initiated by carol -> frontend -> rev 42 -> target image v2.13.7. removing canary route. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rollback complete. canary removed, traffic back to stable. smoke checks passing on stable.

sre-robot: noted: create PR to add redis.serializer=json to values-prod.yaml and add a predeploy lint that compares redis.serializer between staging and prod.

laura: opened PR #4267 -> https://git.internal/redwood/frontend/pull/4267 — adds values-prod.yaml override and a unit test in pipeline.

patrick: also adding a new CI lint rule: env-parity-checker will compare helm keys in staging/prod for a whitelist (redis.serializer included). will add to repo.

carol: filing release notes and action items: rollback reason, prod config missing redis.serializer, PR link, and follow-up to add parity-check in preflight. assigning owners.

jon: also recommend adding a canary preflight that validates common config keys between envs before traffic shift.

laura: ack. will add to PR as a pipeline step.

carol: thanks everyone. closing this thread. we'll schedule a short postmortem in tomorrow's change window to update runbooks and predeploy checks. :pencil:
